從輸入走到輸出逐邊標裝置，只在裝置改變時計一次傳輸；用純CPU結果作功能參考。
回到本階段實驗：畫G-C-G-C-G五段並標輸入輸出的裝置，避免隱藏首尾複製。 ONNX Runtime按execution provider能力分配子圖；本課比較多次跨CPU/GPU邊界。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
steps.instructionEn:
Trace device labels edge-by-edge, counting crossings only on changes, and compare with CPU reference.
Return to the investigation: Draw G-C-G-C-G with input/output residency, including endpoint copies where applicable. ONNX Runtime assigns subgraphs by execution-provider capability; this lab compares CPU/GPU crossings.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。從輸入走到輸出逐邊標裝置，只在裝置改變時計一次傳輸；用純CPU結果作功能參考。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Trace device labels edge-by-edge, counting crossings only on changes, and compare with CPU reference.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
steps.checkEn: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Installed providers without acceleration require capability, priority and dtype checks; wrong outputs suggest layouts. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.

steps.title: provider指派 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Provider assignment · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「provider指派」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Provider assignment and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
provider已安裝卻未加速，查能力、優先順序與不支援dtype；輸出錯查布局轉換。
對照「provider指派」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。以實際分區圖及完整延遲選provider組合，保留可預測CPU回退。
本階段必須重驗：檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
steps.instructionEn:
Installed providers without acceleration require capability, priority and dtype checks; wrong outputs suggest layouts.
Against the nominal Provider assignment result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Choose providers from actual partitions and total latency, retaining predictable CPU fallback.
Reverify this criterion: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。provider已安裝卻未加速，查能力、優先順序與不支援dtype；輸出錯查布局轉換。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Installed providers without acceleration require capability, priority and dtype checks; wrong outputs suggest layouts.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.checkEn: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.

steps.title: provider指派 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Provider assignment · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「provider指派」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Provider assignment and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付provider指派、跨界張量、延遲分解及可重現配置。
在交接件中加入「provider指派」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver provider assignment, crossing tensors, timing and reproducible configuration.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Provider assignment: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
